title: Dotted imports skip executed parent package initializers
reasoning: Resolving `import pkg.child` returns only pkg/child.py. Python also executes pkg/__init__.py, but the tracer never adds that initializer or follows its imports. The documented complete import graph therefore excludes executable source and dependencies.
reproduction: Let main.py import pkg.child, and let pkg/__init__.py import helper. Tracing main.py includes pkg/child.py but omits pkg/__init__.py and helper.py.
recommendation: Include existing package initializers along each resolved module path and trace their imports, while allowing namespace-package directories without initializers.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied test does not exercise package import semantics.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover nested regular packages, namespace packages, and dependencies imported exclusively by parent initializers.
minimumFixScope: Module resolution and dependency collection in imports.py.
